## Checklist

- [ ] One entry per PR, at `content/<category>/<slug>.md`, made from `TEMPLATE.md`
- [ ] I ran this exact prompt text on the model named in `model_tested`, on `date_tested`
- [ ] The Example output is real output from that run, trimmed, not written by me
- [ ] "Why it works" explains the design choices in 2–4 points
- [ ] Project-specific details are `{{placeholders}}`
- [ ] No keys, private links, real people's details, or employer or client information
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] If it's a reusable workflow: `skills/<slug>/SKILL.md` with `name` and `description`
